Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: Current main has GiftiCoordinateDeclaration/DeclaredGiftiSurface placement contracts and current spatial/mvpaSpatial compilation, superseding the old dropped-declaration and historical pin-compile premises. Retained wip/gifti-float64-placement-20261004 still needs reconciliation. N2 CPU tie tests are retained, while N1 inverse-affine/N3 extreme-world and exact downstream/GPU qualification must be individually accounted.

Fresh context: Yes: partial repair / GIFTI re-port.

Next action: Build a current gap matrix rather than repeating all five historical findings: compare placement precision, original identities, observed finite/coverage counts, CPU inverse/overflow and GPU ties. Re-port C6 onto current declarations and independently gate both platforms/consumers.

Evidence: modules/surface/.../gifti/GiftiCoordinates.scala; volume-surface tie receipt; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Follow-up of bd-01M35BHNDCHM6YXCKYX0544TP3 (audit at docs/audits/group-volume-fslr-mapping.md). (1) spatial VolumeToSurfaceOperator and surface-view-three ThreeVolumeProjector reimplement the SurfaceSampling lookup contract: B's trilinear path and GPU float32 tie parity are untested. (2) GiftiSurfaceCodec drops dataSpace/transformedSpace and GeometricType, so a GIFTI's own frame declaration cannot reach route admission. (3) TriangleMesh lacks structural equals; SurfaceGeometry == is array identity (affects SurfaceVertexMapping and engine B's geometry check). (4) SurfaceProjectionReceipt.requestedSamples is computed, not observed, and acceptedSamples counts nonfinite values. (5) spatialJVM does not compile at consumer pin 7c3ff0a against Gale 83cac90 (DMatBuilder.writeLinear) - check whether main already fixed it.
